custom_expected:
1. With View History Logs ON, the user can open the work order's history/audit log (work-order-level history) and it lists change events.
2. The user can also see the line-level history (the line's story/history) on the work-order line, and it lists change events.
3. History logs are for WORK ORDERS ONLY (WO-level and line-level). There is no history log for Part Sales or Purchase Orders, so there is nothing of that kind to check.
custom_preconds:
1. Log in as a user assigned a custom role.
2. The role has the View History Logs toggle turned ON.
3. The role has Work Orders: View turned ON.
4. There is a work order that has at least one line, and both the work order and the line have existing change history.
custom_steps:
1. Open a work order and locate the work-order-level history/audit log section.
2. On the same work order, open an individual line and locate the line-level (line/story) history.
title: View History Logs ON: WO-level and line-level history visible (work orders only)
